MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How many main tones does Mandarin have, not counting the neutral tone? (1 mark)
   A. Six
   B. Three
   C. Four
   D. Two

2. Fill the blank with the word that means "am called": 你好!我____小明。 (1 mark)
   A. 去
   B. 叫
   C. 有
   D. 是

3. What does 谁 (shéi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Younger sister
   B. Older brother
   C. Love
   D. Who

4. Which sentence means "Who is this?"? (1 mark)
   A. 这是谁?
   B. 那是我哥哥。
   C. 这是我爸爸。
   D. 我家有五口人。

5. What is the word order of a simple location sentence in Mandarin? (1 mark)
   A. Place + thing + 在
   B. Thing + place + 在
   C. Thing + 在 + place
   D. 在 + thing + place

6. What does 猫 (māo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Window
   B. Is at, is in
   C. Bathroom
   D. Cat

7. Read the pinyin: wǒ de shēngrì shì sān yuè wǔ hào. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. We sing.
   B. My birthday is on 5 March.
   C. When is your birthday?
   D. We cut the cake.

8. What does 蜡烛 (làzhú) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Candle
   B. Month
   C. To come
   D. Birthday

9. What does 葡萄 (pútao) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Beef
   B. Grapes
   C. Cooked rice
   D. Snacks

10. Which verb goes with 茶? (1 mark)
   A. 吃
   B. 喝
   C. 去
   D. 是

11. Which sentence means "What is this?"? (1 mark)
   A. 这是什么?
   B. 我早饭吃饼。
   C. 我喜欢吃香蕉。
   D. 这是香蕉。

12. "I am in the middle of your face and help you breathe." Which word is the answer? (1 mark)
   A. 脚 jiǎo
   B. 嘴巴 zuǐba
   C. 鼻子 bízi
   D. 头 tóu

13. Which sentence means "I use my eyes to see."? (1 mark)
   A. 我用嘴巴说。
   B. 我用眼睛看。
   C. 我有两只眼睛。
   D. 我用耳朵听。

14. What does 前面 (qiánmiàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. In front of
   B. Door
   C. Table
   D. Television

15. What does 上面 (shàngmiàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Above
   B. Door
   C. Bathroom
   D. Garden

16. Read the pinyin: lǎoshī hǎo! What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. Goodbye!
   B. And you?
   C. Hello, teacher!
   D. My name is Xiaoming.

17. Fill the blank: ____好! (Hello, teacher!) (1 mark)
   A. 朋友
   B. 爸爸
   C. 同学
   D. 老师

18. What is intonation? (1 mark)
   A. The number of strokes
   B. The spelling of a word
   C. How the voice rises and falls
   D. The size of a character

19. What does 房间 (fángjiān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Room
   B. Beside
   C. Where
   D. Left side

20. What does 厨房 (chúfáng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Kitchen
   B. Television
   C. On
   D. Things

21. Which is the short form of 星期? (1 mark)
   A. 学
   B. 家
   C. 去
   D. 周

22. Why should you not shout when reading aloud? (1 mark)
   A. Shouting spoils the tones and hurts the throat
   B. Shouting makes tones clearer
   C. Shouting is quiet
   D. Shouting is polite

23. What does 蔬菜 (shūcài) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Vegetables
   B. Mango
   C. Lunch
   D. Chicken (meat)

24. Read the pinyin: wǒ jiào Xiǎomíng. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. Hello!
   B. Hello! (polite)
   C. Good morning!
   D. My name is Xiaoming.

25. How is a sentence about a person written? (1 mark)
   A. 这是我 + family word + 。
   B. 是这我 + 。
   C. 我这是 + 。
   D. 家有 + 。

26. What does 八 (bā) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Nine
   B. Eight
   C. Five
   D. Ten

27. Which Chinese word means "plate"? (1 mark)
   A. 月 yuè
   B. 蜡烛 làzhú
   C. 祝 zhù
   D. 盘子 pánzi

28. What does 晚饭 (wǎnfàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To drink
   B. Dinner
   C. Grapes
   D. Mango

29. Which word is pronounced niúròu? (1 mark)
   A. 水
   B. 晚饭
   C. 水果
   D. 牛肉

30. Which character means "mouth" and has 3 strokes? (1 mark)
   A. 耳
   B. 头
   C. 手
   D. 口

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. A picture shows a girl but the label says 儿子. Is the pair 对 or 错? Explain. (2 marks)

32. Arrange the words to make a sentence and translate: 礼物 / 送 / 朋友 / 我. (3 marks)

33. Write a plan for a model house: name four rooms or things in Chinese with pinyin and write one sentence about it. (4 marks)

34. Explain how to pause when reading: what does a comma mean and what does a full stop mean? (3 marks)

35. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "What is this?" (2 marks)

36. Give three steps of good imitation when learning a new word. (3 marks)

37. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The sofa is beside the door." (3 marks)

38. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wòshì lǐ yǒu chuáng. (2 marks)

39. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The wind is very light." (2 marks)

40. Give three tips for following spoken instructions well. (3 marks)

41. Explain one similarity and one difference between naming the days in Kiswahili and Chinese. (4 marks)

42. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 椅子 and 谁. (2 marks)

43. Put these pinyin words in alphabetical order: mǐfàn, bǐng, chá. (3 marks)

44. Write a short text of five sentences saying what you eat for each meal, in Chinese with pinyin. (5 marks)

45. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 喜欢 and 哪儿. (2 marks)

46. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The sun is very big." (2 marks)

47. What is the main idea of a text and what are details? Give a short example. (3 marks)

48. Write "Happy birthday to you" in characters and pinyin. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #12 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Four
   Mandarin has four main tones: high level, rising, dipping and falling.

2. B — 叫
   我叫 introduces a name.

3. D — Who
   谁 (shéi) means who.

4. A — 这是谁?
   这是谁? (zhè shì shéi?) means "Who is this?".

5. C — Thing + 在 + place
   For example 冰箱在厨房.

6. D — Cat
   猫 (māo) means cat.

7. B — My birthday is on 5 March.
   wǒ de shēngrì shì sān yuè wǔ hào. is 我的生日是三月五号。, which means "My birthday is on 5 March.".

8. A — Candle
   蜡烛 (làzhú) means candle.

9. B — Grapes
   葡萄 (pútao) means grapes.

10. B — 喝
   We drink tea, so we use 喝.

11. A — 这是什么?
   这是什么? (zhè shì shénme?) means "What is this?".

12. C — 鼻子 bízi
   The nose is in the middle of the face.

13. B — 我用眼睛看。
   我用眼睛看。 (wǒ yòng yǎnjing kàn.) means "I use my eyes to see.".

14. A — In front of
   前面 (qiánmiàn) means in front of.

15. A — Above
   上面 (shàngmiàn) means above.

16. C — Hello, teacher!
   lǎoshī hǎo! is 老师好!, which means "Hello, teacher!".

17. D — 老师
   老师 is teacher.

18. C — How the voice rises and falls
   Intonation is the rise and fall of the voice.

19. A — Room
   房间 (fángjiān) means room.

20. A — Kitchen
   厨房 (chúfáng) means kitchen.

21. D — 周
   周 zhōu means week and is used in 周一 and 周日.

22. A — Shouting spoils the tones and hurts the throat
   Use projection, not shouting.

23. A — Vegetables
   蔬菜 (shūcài) means vegetables.

24. D — My name is Xiaoming.
   wǒ jiào Xiǎomíng. is 我叫小明。, which means "My name is Xiaoming.".

25. A — 这是我 + family word + 。
   For example 这是我爸爸。

26. B — Eight
   八 (bā) means eight.

27. D — 盘子 pánzi
   盘子 (pánzi) means plate.

28. B — Dinner
   晚饭 (wǎnfàn) means dinner.

29. D — 牛肉
   牛肉 is pronounced niúròu and means beef.

30. D — 口
   口 kǒu.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: 错 (wrong). 儿子 means son, but the picture shows a girl.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for saying 错 and 1 mark for the reason.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: 朋友送我礼物。 My friend gives me a gift.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for 。, 1 mark for the translation.

33. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example 厨房 chúfáng, 客厅 kètīng, 卧室 wòshì, 床 chuáng. Sentence: 床在卧室。
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each name with pinyin, 1 mark for a correct sentence.

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: A comma is a short pause and a full stop is a longer pause, so you can breathe and the listener can follow.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for comma, 1 mark for full stop, 1 mark for the reason.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是什么? zhè shì shénme?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: Listen to the whole word, repeat it slowly, compare with the speaker and correct.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: 沙发在门旁边。 shāfā zài mén pángbiān.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

38. (2 marks)
   Answer: There is a bed in the bedroom.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: 风很小。 fēng hěn xiǎo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: Listen to the whole instruction; catch the key words; ask for a repeat if unsure; show the answer by pointing or drawing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each tip.

41. (4 marks)
   Answer: Similarity: both use numbers to make day names. Difference: Chinese counts from Monday (星期一 is week one) but Kiswahili counts from Saturday (Jumatatu, Monday, has tatu, three).
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for the similarity and 2 marks for the difference with an example.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: 椅子: yǐzi, chair. 谁: shéi, who.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: bǐng, chá, mǐfàn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct position.

44. (5 marks)
   Answer: 我早饭吃饼,喝茶。我午饭吃米饭和鸡肉。我晚饭吃米饭和菠菜。我喜欢水果。 wǒ zǎofàn chī bǐng, hē chá. wǒ wǔfàn chī mǐfàn hé jīròu. wǒ wǎnfàn chī mǐfàn hé bōcài. wǒ xǐhuan shuǐguǒ.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence with correct verbs and pinyin.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: 喜欢: xǐhuan, to like. 哪儿: nǎr, where.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: 太阳很大。 tàiyáng hěn dà.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: The main idea is what the whole text is about, for example "my home". Details are facts that support it, for example "there is a sofa in the living room".
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for main idea, 1 mark for details, 1 mark for the example.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: 祝你生日快乐! zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.
